caption:
#ad Fast eaters turn mealtimes into a marathon with this clever little bowl. Just spread some tasty paste over all the bumps and watch them focus. It works wonders during bath time or whenever your pup needs a calm distraction.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

#dogs #mealtimes #puppy #slowfeeder
brief: Wobble lick bowl for dogs: a rubber bowl full of small bumps. Spread wet food or a treat paste into the bumps, and licking it up takes longer, so fast eaters slow down and mealtime lasts. Good for fast eaters, bath time and quiet time. Not for dogs that chew or tear soft rubber. Playful tone: dinner served, dinner gone.
